assessment.note: All report Hengshun vinegar-series (醋系列) revenue: 2024 ≈ 12.66亿元 and 2023 ≈ 12.94亿元. p1/p2/p49/p50 are the same Sina/Stockstar annual-report table (shared underlying source, not independent); p16/p17 (lhratings) and p28/p65 (guancha) restate the same annual-report figures. Use one definition (p1/p2) for series work.

Foreign-trade (外贸模式) channel revenue: 2024 ≈ 4,774万元, 2023 ≈ 4,513万元, 2025 ≈ 3,917万元. p4/p5 and p53/p54 are the same annual-report channel table from two aggregators; treat as one source. This is the key export-revenue anchor but covers all products and all destinations, not just vinegar or the US.

Total revenue ~21.96亿元 (2024) / 21.06亿元 (2023) appears in several tables with different subtotals (by-channel 209,301万 vs by-product 177,417万 vs operating revenue 21.96亿). These are different table scopes of the same annual report, not independent measurements; do not mix them in one ratio.
Vinegar-series production 21.06万吨 and sales 21.27万吨 in 2024, from a single guancha article (duplicated ids). Gives a physical volume anchor for the vinegar segment.

One customs-derived dataset (m.x315.cn) for HS 22090000 exports, cumulative 2020-2022: US 6.60 million L (11.35% of 58.1 million L worldwide). Internally consistent; single source, three-year cumulative, all Chinese exporters — needs annualisation and a Hengshun-share transfer.

Zhenjiang Customs series of Zhenjiang vinegar exports 2015-2019 (280→622 t, ~$0.9-1.0/kg). Consistent internally but old, city-wide (all Zhenjiang producers), and all destinations — usable only as a scale/price analogue, not a direct US figure.
Hengshun export/US retail bottle sizes cluster at 500-580 mL, mostly 500 mL; supports a ~500 mL average bottle assumption with a modest spread.
US retail prices for Hengshun 500 mL vinegar: $3-$7 (2020) and $3.29 (2026 Weee). Consistent order of magnitude; retail, not import, price.

One bill of lading for Chinkiang (not Hengshun-branded) vinegar, 550 mL×24; container dimensions are garbled (240×102×96 cm is not a real 20-ft box). Illustrates pack configuration only; cannot anchor volume.
Density ~1.01 g/cm³ for dilute acetic acid; supports ton↔liter conversion. p107/p108 (1.24 g/cm³ lab liquid) are a different substance and irrelevant.

methods.rationale: Revenue route (d1): export revenue (p4, 4,774万元) × vinegar share (a1) × US share (a2) gives US vinegar revenue; dividing by bottle volume (a3) and density (a4) converts to bottles. Requires a revenue-to-volume bridge: implicitly assumes export price per liter equals the domestic average implied by p1/p26 (vinegar revenue / sales volume), so the formula's unit is bottles only if p4 is treated as a volume-equivalent at that price. Failure modes: a1 and a2 are the dominant uncertainties; p4 covers all products and destinations.

a2.role: US share of Hengshun vinegar export volume, 2024

a3.role: average export bottle fill volume in mL

methods.rationale: Physical-flow route (d4): vinegar sales volume (p26, 21.27万吨) × export revenue share of total revenue (p4/p7) gives export vinegar tonnage; × US share (a2) gives US tonnage; ÷ density (a4) and bottle volume (a3) gives bottles. Assumes export revenue share equals export volume share and that all export tonnage is vinegar (slight overstatement since sauce/wine also export). Failure modes: p4/p7 mixes channel-table and product-table scopes; a2 dominates uncertainty.

methods.rationale: Customs route (d2): national US-bound vinegar volume (p33, 6.60 million L over 2020-2022) × annualisation (a6) × Hengshun share (a5) ÷ bottle volume (a3) gives Hengshun US bottles. Independent of the company revenue route, so it provides a genuine cross-check. Failure modes: p33 is three-year cumulative and pre-2024 (tariff/shipping shifts since 2022 unmodelled beyond a6); a5 is a broad transfer assumption; HS 2209 includes non-vinegar substitutes.

assumptions.name: Vinegar share of Hengshun foreign-trade revenue
assumptions.rationale: Hengshun's export channel sells vinegar plus sauce and wine; vinegar is the flagship (醋系列 is ~57% of total revenue, p1/p9) and the best-known export product, so vinegar likely dominates but not exclusively. Range spans a sauce/wine-heavy to vinegar-dominant mix.
assumptions.applies_when: Using total 外贸 revenue (p4) as the base for vinegar export revenue.
assumptions.falsified_by: Annual-report disclosure of overseas revenue by product showing vinegar share outside 40-80%.

assumptions.name: US share of Hengshun vinegar export volume
assumptions.rationale: China's HS 2209 exports to the US are 11.35% of worldwide (p35), but Hengshun skews toward Southeast Asia/overseas-Chinese markets (HK, Singapore, Malaysia dominate p38-p44); US is a secondary but growing market. Set slightly above the national US share to reflect Hengshun's brand presence in US Asian supermarkets, with wide range.
assumptions.applies_when: Converting Hengshun total vinegar export volume to US-bound volume.
assumptions.falsified_by: Company or customs data showing US share of Hengshun exports below 8% or above 40%.

assumptions.name: Average Hengshun export bottle fill volume
assumptions.rationale: Kept export/US retail SKUs (p82-p93, p99-p103) cluster at 500 mL with some 535-580 mL; 500 mL is the modal export bottle.
assumptions.applies_when: Converting vinegar volume (liters) to bottle count.
assumptions.falsified_by: Evidence that US-bound Hengshun SKUs are predominantly larger (e.g., 1 L) or smaller (e.g., 300 mL) formats.

assumptions.falsified_by: Measured density of Hengshun export vinegar outside 0.99-1.05 kg/L.

assumptions.applies_when: Applying a Hengshun share to national US-bound HS 2209 volume (p33 annualised).

kept.rationale: Hengshun export/US SKUs observed at 500, 535, 550, 580 mL (p82-p92, p99-p103), with 500 mL most common; a volume-weighted average slightly above 500 mL reflects the mix.

kept.falsified_by: Evidence that US-bound Hengshun product is predominantly small (200-300 mL) or bulk packaging.

kept.name: Hengshun share of China HS22090000 vinegar export value

kept.applies_when: Hengshun's customs-recorded vinegar exports are a leading but minority share of national HS22090000 exports.
kept.falsified_by: Customs or company data showing Hengshun's vinegar exports are <3% or >30% of national HS22090000 exports.

kept.name: US share of Hengshun's HS22090000 vinegar export value
kept.rationale: National HS22090000 data put the US at ~11-17% of China's vinegar export value (p128 vs p131; p35), but Hengshun is a premium branded exporter with stronger US retail presence than the average Chinese exporter, so its US share should sit above the national average. Range spans a national-average-lik
kept.applies_when: Hengshun's export destinations are spread roughly in line with branded Chinese vinegar trade, with the US a leading single market.
kept.falsified_by: Evidence that Hengshun's US sales are <5% or >60% of its vinegar export value.

residual_risks: The searcher sees post-cutoff search results and chooses which URLs are fetched, so page selection can be conditioned on the answer; only the URLs leave the searcher, and in backtests every fetched page is a snapshot dated <= as_of.
Live pages are used only when as_of is today; in backtests every page is an archived snapshot dated <= as_of.
The leak sentinel only catches registered official values in common formats, not paraphrased or derived numbers.
The model's own training data (knowledge cutoff unpublished) can include history before as_of; it cannot include the target if the target was published after the model's release.
Wayback snapshots are captured by a third party; a snapshot date <= as_of proves the content existed by then.
Assumption values are proposed by the judge model from its own knowledge, which can include the target's history before as_of; code checks their form, not where the number came from.
